title: Majority coefficients across odd dimensions
statement: Let $m$ and $j$ be nonnegative integers with $j\\le m$. Let $S$ be a set of coordinates in a cube of dimension $2m$ and $T$ a set of coordinates in a cube of dimension $2m+3$, each of cardinality $2j+1$. The Fourier coefficient of majority on the $(2m+3)$-dimensional cube at $T$ equals $\\frac{2(m-j)+1}{2(m+1)}$ times the Fourier coefficient of majority on the $(2m+1)$-dimensional cube at $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\\{0,\\ldots,2m-1\\}$ with cardinality $2j+1$
$T$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\\{0,\\ldots,2m+2\\}$ with cardinality $2j+1$
